close_reason: Introduced NcTypeMask newtype with inherent constants and BitOrAssign impl. All NC_TYPE_* sites updated to use .contains() instead of & != 0.
description: NC_TYPE_RFC822, NC_TYPE_DNS, etc. are bare u32 consts. nc_constrained_types is u32. The bitmask operations are correct but the type offers no protection: passing any u32 as nc_constrained_types compiles without complaint. A newtype wrapping u32 with named bit operations, or the bitflags crate, would make the intent self-documenting and prevent accidental mixing. The current approach is functional but the problem domain (name type constraints) has a fixed, closed set of variants that maps naturally to a bitflags struct.
title: NC_TYPE_* constants should be a bitflags or u32 newtype, not bare u32 consts
